content:
maria (runtime): Cascade (cust:cascade-health) reported a ~40% throughput drop on their Dedicated pool c-82 in eu-west-1 starting ~2026-03-15T03:00Z. Ticket #12347 opened by support. Can we triage?
cheng (eng-runtime): grabbing metrics now. quick q — is this across all models or just the default r-instruct-13b?
maria (runtime): support says it's across text-gen routes, but heavy on r-instruct-13b. Latency stable-ish, requests/sec down.
sre-oncall-bot: Grafana: https://graf.redwood/g/cluster-cascade/eu-west-1/c-82/slo?from=2026-03-15T00:00Z&to=2026-03-15T06:00Z (snapshot attached) :eyes:
oliver (eng-runtime): I rolled kernel perf PR #3421 to eu-west canary yesterday at 02:30Z — did canary finish?
cheng (eng-runtime): canary showed +2% p50 perf on micro-benchmarks, but I didn't see canary->prod promotion logs. checking deploy history...
support-bot: Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-12347 — customer reported throughput drop at 03:05Z. Sam (acct-mgr) cc'd.
sam (acct-mgr): I'm on call with the customer in 10m, need ETA for mitigation.
lina (perf): I'll run the reproduce harness against c-82 with a synthetic steady workload (batch sizes 8/16) and collect GPU metrics + nvprof traces. Starting now.
maria (runtime): can someone paste recent autoscaler logs? wondering if scale-in got aggressive.
sre-oncall-bot: Autoscaler events for c-82: 
```
2026-03-15T01:45Z scale_out: +2 pods (reason: cpu sustained > 70%)
2026-03-15T02:55Z scale_in: -3 pods (reason: policy: aggressive-scale-in)
2026-03-15T03:10Z scale_out: +1 pod (reason: short spike)
```
cheng (eng-runtime): scale_in at 02:55Z is suspicious. correlated with drop start. maybe policy too aggressive given continuous batching.
oliver (eng-runtime): Also there's a kernel fallback path that got toggled in PR #3421 when mem pressure fluctuates — could cause throughput churn. I can roll back the canary if needed.
maria (runtime): ok plan: (1) Lina runs repro + traces (2) Cheng inspects autoscaler policy and temp disable aggressive scale-in for c-82 (3) Oliver prepare rollback PR for kernel change -> ready to trigger if traces point there. Sam, tell customer we're actively triaging and may toggle config or rollback.
sam (acct-mgr): told them we'll update in 30m, they appreciate the quick response.
lina (perf): repro harness results (10m after start): baseline steady-state before 02:55Z = 520 reqs/s, after = 310 reqs/s. GPU util avg dropped from 78% -> 42% on several nodes. nvprof attached: shows frequent kernel restarts and increased memcpy stalls.
cheng (eng-runtime): disabling aggressive scale-in on c-82 now (temp). patch applied: `infra/autoscaler: set min_stable_window=6m` — will monitor.
maria (runtime): nice. Lina, do nvprof traces show kernel variant changes?
lina (perf): yes: timeline shows switch from optimized-kernel-v2 -> fallback-kernel-v1 around 02:56Z on 3 pods. memcpy stalls spike after switch.
oliver (eng-runtime): that's consistent with #3421 behavior. Rolling back canary across eu-west now. Triggering rollback at 03:18Z.
sre-oncall-bot: Rollback started. Rollback logs: 03:18Z rollback requested, 03:21Z rollback complete on c-82 canary nodes.
maria (runtime): monitoring throughput...
sre-oncall-bot: Post-rollback metrics (03:25Z snapshot): reqs/s rising from 320 -> 510 over 6m. p95 latency unchanged.
sam (acct-mgr): told customer we rolled back kernel changes and adjusted autoscaler temporarily. customer says they're seeing improvements.
maria (runtime): follow-ups: (a) OLiver to submit revert PR for production rollout blockers and add safer fallback gating, (b) Cheng to propose autoscaler policy tweak org-wide for dedicated pools with batching, (c) Lina to attach full traces + perf writeup to ticket. I'll update RED-12347 with postmortem.
oliver (eng-runtime): will open PR with test harness and extra gating flags.
cheng (eng-runtime): will draft autoscaler RFC.
lina (perf): uploading traces & short analysis to the ticket now.
maria (runtime): thanks everyone. closing loop with customer in 45m after monitoring period. :thumbsup:
